snippet.title: Girls' Frontline: The Lunasia Covenant | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Girls' Frontline: The Lunasia Covenant | Official Reveal Trailer

Time marches ever onward. The world is transformed anew.

A world-spanning behemoth.
A realm born from the void.
A power forged by legend.
And beyond it all, the blue butterfly watches.

In the liminal space between [Reality], [Virtuality], and [...], new seeds quietly take root.

Let bullets write the next chapter.
Let courage forge our edge.
一As we always have.

—————————————————

Girls' Frontline: The Lunasia Covenant is Sunborn Network's upcoming PvE game, blending third-person shooter action with cooperative combat.

※The game is currently in development. Stay tuned for more updates!

#GirlsFrontlineTheLunasiaCovenant #GFLLC #GFLTheLunasiaCovenant
